info.name: Get Fuel and Energy Efficiency Driver Reports.

params.name: startDate
params.description: A start date in RFC 3339 format. This parameter ignores everything (i.e. hour, minutes, seconds, nanoseconds, etc.) besides the date and timezone. If no time zone is passed in, then the UTC time zone will be used. This parameter is inclusive, so data on the date specified will be considered. Note that the most recent 72 hours of data may still be processing and is subject to change and latency, so it is not recommended to request data for the most recent 72 hours. For example, 2022-07-13T14:20:50.52-07:00 is a time in Pacific Daylight Time.

params.name: endDate
params.description: An end date in RFC 3339 format. This parameter ignores everything (i.e. hour, minutes, seconds, nanoseconds, etc.) besides the date and timezone. If no time zone is passed in, then the UTC time zone will be used. This parameter is inclusive, so data on the date specified will be considered. Note that the most recent 72 hours of data may still be processing and is subject to change and latency, so it is not recommended to request data for the most recent 72 hours. For example, 2022-07-13T14:20:50.52-07:00 is a time in Pacific Daylight Time.

params.name: driverIds
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of driver IDs and externalIds. Example: `driverIds=1234,5678,payroll:4841`

params.name: tagIds
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of tag IDs. Example: `tagIds=1234,5678`

params.name: parentTagIds
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of parent tag IDs, for use by orgs with tag hierarchies. Specifying a parent tag will implicitly include all descendent tags of the parent tag. Example: `parentTagIds=345,678`

params.name: after
params.description: If specified, this should be the endCursor value from the previous page of results. When present, this request will return the next page of results that occur immediately after the previous page of results.

params.name: year
params.description: The year of the requested IFTA report summary. Must be provided with a month or quarter param. Example: `year=2021`

params.name: month
params.description: The month of the requested IFTA report summary. Can not be provided with the quarter param. Example: `month=January`  Valid values: `January`, `February`, `March`, `April`, `May`, `June`, `July`, `August`, `September`, `October`, `November`, `December`

params.name: quarter
params.description: The quarter of the requested IFTA report summary. Can not be provided with the month param. Q1: January, February, March. Q2: April, May, June. Q3: July, August, September. Q4: October, November, December. Example: `quarter=Q1`  Valid values: `Q1`, `Q2`, `Q3`, `Q4`

params.name: jurisdictions
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of jurisdictions. Example: `jurisdictions=GA`

params.name: fuelType
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of IFTA fuel types. Example: `fuelType=Diesel`  Valid values: `Unspecified`, `A55`, `Biodiesel`, `CompressedNaturalGas`, `Diesel`, `E85`, `Electricity`, `Ethanol`, `Gasohol`, `Gasoline`, `Hydrogen`, `LiquifiedNaturalGas`, `M85`, `Methanol`, `Propane`, `Other`
